necessary_context.content: P(w)=n^{-1} sum_i psi_i(w), psi_i:R^d -> R; unconstrained Euclidean minimization.
necessary_context.name: Finite-sum objective

necessary_context.content: Each component is convex and smooth; P is gamma-strongly convex, with L >= gamma > 0 for Theorem 1. Eq. (6) uses squared Euclidean norm. Eq. (5) visibly lacks a square on its norm; do not treat the displayed unsquared expression as the standard L-smoothness definition. The proof uses quadratic smoothness.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.2 Eqs. (5)-(6); p.3 Section 3 and Theorem 1; p.4 first proof paragraph
necessary_context.name: Standing conditions and source issue

necessary_context.content: Each epoch output is a random inner iterate indexed in {0,...,m-1}; the proof uses its uniform average in expectation. Option I outputs w_m and is outside this proof.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.4 Figure 1; p.5 first proof display
necessary_context.name: Option II
